8.name: January 7, 2026
8.overview: Hangman Page and Swerve Strickland team up to face Hook and Powerhouse Hobbs in a Lights Out match. Toni Storm battles Marina Shafir. Bandido defends his Ring of Honor World Championship against Sammy Guevara. Title Eliminator Match: AEW Continental Champion Jon Moxley vs. Shelton Benjamin. MJF appears live in Tulsa, Oklahoma.

8.name: Maximum Carnage - January 14, 2026
8.overview: All Elite Wrestling presents Maximum Carnage as MJF puts his World Title on the line against Bandido. The Babes of Wrath become a cosmic trio as Kris Statlander joins Harley Cameron and Willow Nightingale to fight the Triangle of Madness. Darby Allin goes one-on-one against PAC. Kenny Omega in singles action.

8.name: January 21, 2026
8.overview: The Don Callis Family fights the Death Riders in a wild six-man tag team street fight. Megan Bayne and Penelope Ford return to tag team action against the Timeless Love Bombs. Kenny Omega faces Josh Alexander. After losing the trios titles last week, Samoa Joe has a score to settle with new champion Speedball Mike Bailey. Kevin Knight vs. Swerve Strickland.

8.name: January 28, 2026
8.overview: "The Toxic Spider" Thekla challenges Kris Statlander for her AEW Women's World Title. All Elite Wrestling Tag Team Champions FTR defend against the Don Callis Family's brutes Mark Davis and Jake Doyle. Mark Briscoe puts his TNT Title on the line against the undefeated El Clon.

8.name: February 4, 2026
8.overview: Brody King challenges champion MJF in a World Title Eliminator Match. Kenny Omega faces Andrade El Idolo. Ricochet defends his National Title against Jack Perry. Don Callis Family's Mark Davis goes one-on-one against Hangman Adam Page.

8.name: February 11, 2026
8.overview: Kris Statlander defends the AEW Women's World Championship against Thekla in a Strap Match. Kenny Omega and Swerve Strickland meet face-to-face. The Young Bucks take on The Rascalz and a wild card team to determine the next challengers for the World Tag Team Titles. Kyle Fletcher aims to reclaim the TNT Title against champion Tommaso Ciampa.

8.name: February 18, 2026
8.overview: For the first time ever, Kenny Omega faces Swerve Strickland in singles competition. Hangman Adam Page goes face-to-face with the man he'll challenge at the Revolution pay-per-view: All Elite Wrestling World Champion MJF. The Brawling Birds tag team (Jamie Hayter and Alex Windsor) makes its in-ring debut.

8.name: February 25, 2026
8.overview: Jon Moxley battles El Clon. Prior to meeting at REVOLUTION, MJF and Hangman Adam Page decide the stipulation for their World Title match.

8.name: March 4, 2026
8.overview: Thekla has her first defense of the AEW Women's Championship as she faces former titleholder Thunder Rosa. World Champion MJF puts his belt on the line against the talented Kevin Knight. The debut of The Iinspiration, as they face the Brawling Birds.

8.name: March 11, 2026
8.overview: Tensions rise before AEW: Revolution as MJF and Hangman Page hold a high-stakes press conference. TBS Champ Willow Nightingale faces Persephone, and TNT Champ Kyle Fletcher battles Mike Bailey. Tommaso Ciampa joins forces with FTR to fight Mark Briscoe and the Young Bucks. Orange Cassidy and Darby Allin team up against the new AEW hires Gabe Kidd and David Finlay.

8.name: March 18, 2026
8.overview: Death-defying daredevil Darby Allin battles the ruthless Gabe Kidd in a Coffin Match. There are "No Holds Barred" as Timeless Toni Storm clashes with the Deathriders' Marina Shafir. In the aftermath of AEW: Revolution pay-per-view, All Elite Wrestling is live from Fresno.

8.name: March 25, 2026
8.overview: All Elite Wrestling is live from St. Paul, Minnesota. Kenny Omega faces Swerve Strickland with Swerve's #1 contender spot on the line against Omega's EVP title. AEW Women's Champion Thekla defends against Mina Shirakawa. Darby Allin vs. Rush. Following his victory in the brutal Texas Death Match at Revolution, MJF returns.

8.name: April 1, 2026
8.overview: The road to AEW: Dynasty heats up as World Champion MJF and challenger Kenny Omega sign the contract for their pay-per-view match. PAC battles Will Ospreay. Triangle of Madness faces Mina Shirakawa and the Brawling Birds. The Demand faces Brody King, Jack Perry, and Omega.

8.name: April 8, 2026
8.overview: Chris Jericho is back and will address the fans regarding his AEW return. Darby Allin, Jack Perry, and Brody King joins forces to battle the Don Callis Family's Andrade el Ídolo, Konosuke Takeshita, and Mark Davis. Championship gold is on the line as Willow Nightingale defends her TBS Title against Queen Aminata. Kenny Omega speaks out ahead of his World Title challenge against MJF at Sunday's AEW Dynasty pay-per-view.

8.name: Dynamite: Spring Breakthru - April 15, 2026
8.overview: In a monumental development, AEW World Champion MJF faces Darby Allin. Kamille is back and will fight Willow Nightingale. Following his win in the Casino Gauntlet match at AEW Revolution, Kevin Knight defends his newly won TNT Title against Claudio Castagnoli.

8.name: April 22, 2026
8.overview: New AEW World Champion Darby Allin addresses the fans and takes on Tommaso Ciampa. Will Ospreay goes one-on-one with Mark Davis. Mina Shirakawa faces Hikaru Shida.

8.name: April 29, 2026
8.overview: Friendships will be set aside as World Champion Darby Allin faces off against Brody King. Hikaru Shida and Kris Statlander are determined to prove they can get the job done as they challenge Divine Dominion for the AEW Women's World Tag Team titles. Will the mind games continue as MJF battles TNT Champion Kevin Knight?

8.name: May 6, 2026
8.overview: It's Double Jeopardy as Tag Team Champion Dax Harwood (of FTR) battles Trios Champion Orange Cassidy (of The Conglomeration). Juice Robinson and Jon Moxley tangle in an AEW Continental Championship Eliminator match. Harley Cameron and Mina Shirakawa face Hikaru Shida and Kris Statlander, but will these alliances hold?

8.name: May 13, 2026
8.overview: Konosuke Takeshita steps up to challenge fighting AEW World Champion Darby Allin. MJF addresses his high-stakes Hair vs. Title match at Double or Nothing. Ospreay returns to action against Ace Austin. Hikaru Shida links up with the Brawling Birds to battle the Triangle of Madness. In ten-man action, FTR, the Dogs, and Ciampa fight Copeland, Christian, Orange Cassidy, and the Young Bucks. "The Jet" Kevin Knight holds an open challenge for his TNT Title. Both the Men's and Women's Owen Hart Tournament brackets are revealed.

8.name: May 20, 2026
8.overview: Relentless World Champion Darby Allin has agreed to face Speedball Mike Bailey. FTR must put the AEW Tag Team Titles on the line against Conglomeration's Roderick Strong and Orange Cassidy. The unpredictable Mark Briscoe and the Psycho Killer Tommaso Ciampa will both be in their element as they battle in an "Anything Goes" match.

8.name: Dynamite 5/27/2026
8.overview: MJF holds an epic celebration to commemorate winning the AEW World Championship for a third time. Everyone is banned from ringside as Chris Jericho battles Ricochet. It's a "Lights Out Philly Street Fight" as Kris Statlander seeks revenge on Hikaru Shida. Kyle Fletcher explains why he chose the Don Callis Family over his friend Takeshita.

8.name: June 3, 2026
8.overview: All Elite Wrestling World Champion MJF puts the title on the line against RUSH in his first defense since winning the belt at Double or Nothing. A former partnership is completely shattered as "Speedball" Mike Bailey battles his former JetSpeed teammate, TNT Champion Kevin Knight. The 2026 Owen Hart Foundation Tournament continues, as Alex Windsor enters the Women's quarterfinals and Will Ospreay goes one-on-one against Mark Davis in the Men's semifinals. AEW Dynamite is live from Richmond, Virginia!

8.name: Dynamite: Summer Blockbuster 2026
8.overview: It's time for AEW Dynamite: Summer Blockbuster! Swerve Strickland battles Brody King in the semifinals of the Owen Hart Foundation Men's tournament. Jon Moxley puts his AEW Continental Title on the line against Shane Taylor. Japan's Sareee makes her AEW debut against Skye Blue in the quarterfinals of the Owen Hart Foundation Women's tournament. Orange Cassidy faces Andrade El Idolo. Live from Cincinnati, Ohio!

8.name: June 17, 2026
8.overview: MJF and Mark Briscoe choose the loyal teammates who will follow them into a brutal Steel Cage battle at Forbidden Door. Ahead of the highly anticipated 2026 Owen Hart Men's Tournament Finals, Will Ospreay and Swerve Strickland meet face-to-face. Mercedes Moné goes one-on-one with Stardom's Hazuki to determine who will advance to the finals of the 2026 Owen Hart Women's Tournament.

8.name: June 24, 2026
8.overview: Konosuke Takeshita defends the International Title against Ricochet. Místico joins Brodido to face the Death Riders. In TBS Title Survival of the Fittest Qualifying matches, Marina Shafir takes on Harley Cameron, and Queen Aminata battles Red Velvet. Before colliding with Kenny Omega at Forbidden Door, NJPW star Zack Sabre Jr. goes one-on-one against Jack Perry. The Young Bucks in action against NJPW's TMDK.

8.name: July 1, 2026
8.overview: Following his team's victory in the 12-man steel cage match at Forbidden Door, Mark Briscoe is ready to challenge AEW World Champion MJF. Six women have qualified to compete in the Survival of the Fittest match. Now, will it be Hikaru Shida, Harley Cameron, Persephone, Queen Aminata, Maika, or Kris Statlander leaving San Diego as the new AEW TBS Champion?

8.name: Dynamite: Beach Break 2026
8.overview: Kenny Omega is willing to put everything on the line as he challenges champion MJF for the AEW World Title. Chris Jericho and Tommaso Ciampa finally go one-on-one. Beach Break holds a Women's Casino Gauntlet match, with the winner earning a match against the World Champion at the Redemption pay-per-view. Friends no more, Kyle Fletcher takes on AEW International Champion Konosuke Takeshita.

8.name: July 15, 2026
8.overview: New AEW World Champion Kenny Omega appears. Andrade El Ídolo is seeking revenge on the Don Callis Family, starting with Jake Doyle. In huge trios action, Willow Nightingale joins Maya World and Hyan to face Mercedes Moné and Divine Dominion. AEW Dynamite is live from Boston!

8.name: July 22, 2026
8.overview: AEW World Champion Kenny Omega joins forces with Jon Moxley and Will Ospreay to face the Don Callis Family. Kevin Knight just set the TNT Title defense record, but to keep the belt he'll need to overcome challenger Darby Allin. Fresh off winning gold in Japan, the Sisters of Sin have challenged the AEW Women's Tag Team Champions Divine Dominion to a No Disqualification title match. Bang Bang Gang's Jay White goes one-on-one against The Dogs' Clark Connors.

8.name: July 29, 2026
8.overview: The Conglomeration puts their AEW World Trios Title on the line against The Demand. Willow Nightingale celebrates her Women's World Championship victory. Young Bucks and AEW Tag Team Champions Cage & Cope agree to sit down with Renee Paquette.

8.name: Grand Slam: Mexico 2026
8.overview: It's Grand Slam: Mexico live from Arena México! Mark Davis tries to derail Will Ospreay's path to Wembley in a Mexico City Street Fight. The Demand defend the AEW World Trios Title vs. Hangman Page, Bandido, and Brody King. Kyle Fletcher and Speedball Bailey renew their rivalry as they fight for the International Title. Willow Nightingale and the Brawling Birds face the imposing trio of Mercedes Moné and Divine Dominion, and much more on a special 2.5-hour night of wrestling!

8.name: August 12, 2026
8.overview: After his shocking return at Grand Slam Mexico, MJF joins a three-way fight with Nick Wayne and Speedball Mike Bailey seeking the No. 2 spot in the All In London Casino Gauntlet match. Jericho vs. champion Kevin Knight for the TNT Title. The Continental Challenge Cup continues as Jay White faces David Finlay amid their fierce years-long rivalry, and Jack Perry goes one-on-one against the Death Riders' Jon Moxley for the first time ever. All Elite Wrestling is live from Las Vegas.

8.name: August 19, 2026
8.overview: AEW World Champion Kenny Omega and his challenger at All In London, Will Ospreay, each face the Don Callis Family in separate trios matches. In addition, Kenny and Will sit down together with Renee Paquette. TBS Champion Maya World defends her title in a four-way match against Kris Statlander, Persephone, and Hikaru Shida after weeks of tension among them. The Continental Challenge Cup Quarterfinals begin.

8.name: August 26, 2026
8.overview: From Glasgow's OVO Hydro, it's the final AEW Dynamite before All In: London. The Continental Challenge Cup Semifinals see two Death Riders square off as Jon Moxley faces Claudio Castagnoli, and Conglomeration's Kyle O'Reilly takes on the UK's Nigel McGuinness. Also, Swerve Strickland goes one-on-one with Jack Perry, MJF appears, and National Champion Andrade has something to say.

8.name: September 2, 2026
8.overview: In the wake of the epic All In: London from Wembley Stadium, it's the AEW Dynamite debut of The New Level, Austin Creed and Kofi! They will team with Swerve Strickland to defend their newly won AEW World Trios Championship against The Rascalz. Also, Mercedes Moné has won the AEW Women's World Title, and she's going to have her celebration ceremony.

8.name: Rebel Heart Special - September 9, 2026
8.overview: All Elite Wrestling honors Rebel in her fight against ALS. David Finlay challenges champion Will Ospreay in an AEW World Title Eliminator match. Swerve Strickland and The New Level defend their AEW World Trios titles against The Conglomeration. Young Bucks face the Don Callis Family's Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight in a Tables match. Plus, Dr. Britt Baker, DMD and Rebel present "The Waiting Room" with special guests Persephone & Hikaru Shida.

8.name: September 16, 2026
8.overview: Jericho goes one-on-one with the brash young star Nick Wayne. The United Empire has gathered their forces with Andrade El Ídolo and Francesco Akira joining AEW World Champion Will Ospreay to take on the Death Riders' trio of Jon Moxley, PAC and Gabe Kidd. AEW Dynamite is live from the Chartway Arena in Norfolk, Virginia!

8.name: September 23, 2026
8.overview: The New Level and Swerve Strickland put their All Elite Wrestling Trios titles on the line as they face The Demand (Ricochet, Toa Liona, and Bishop Kaun). The winners of the match will go on to face the Hangman, Brody King, and Bandido at the All Out pay-per-view on Saturday, September 26.

8.name: A Tribute to PAC: September 30, 2026
8.overview: All Elite Wrestling comes together to honor the life, career, and legacy of the outstanding wrestler PAC.

8.name: Dynamite: Grand Slam: France 2026
8.overview: All Elite Wrestling crosses the Atlantic for a special Tuesday night Dynamite -- Grand Slam: France! World Champion Will Ospreay puts his title on the line against Kazuchika Okada. AEW Women's Champion Mercedes Moné defends against Queen Aminata. Kyle Fletcher challenges Darby Allin for his TNT Championship. Chris Jericho goes one-on-one against Nick Wayne.

8.name: October 14, 2026
8.overview: A special AEW Dynamite from Cleveland features five Clockwork Carnage Qualifying Matches to determine the remaining challengers for AEW World Champion Will Ospreay at Saturday's WrestleDream pay-per-view. Plus, the Don Callis Family's Wardlow, Mark Davis, and Jake Doyle throw down against the Deathriders in trios action.

8.name: October 21, 2026
8.overview: Following the wild events at WrestleDream, AEW Dynamite is live from Coral Gables, Florida. The newest signing in All Elite Wrestling, Ilja Dragunov, makes his in-ring debut against Speedball Mike Bailey. After fighting one another in Clockwork Carnage, World Champion Will Ospreay teams with Adam Copeland against Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight.

8.name: Dynamite: Fright Night Dynamite 2026
8.overview: A special "Fright Night" edition of AEW Dynamite live from St. Louis, Missouri. Darby Allin puts his TNT Title on the line against the "Walking Weapon" Josh Alexander, while Persephone defends her TBS Championship against Queen Aminata. The high-stakes best-of-five tag team series reaches a pivotal Match 3 as FTR collides with the Motor City Machine Guns.
